exam_scheme.note: The AIMS Test for Management Admissions (ATMA) is a national-level computer-based test conducted by the Association of Indian Management Schools (AIMS) multiple times a year (typically across February, May, June, and July test windows). ATMA is recognized by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, and AICTE for admissions to MBA, PGDM, MMS, and MCA programmes across more than 500 participating management institutes. The test duration is 180 minutes (3 hours) with 180 multiple choice questions divided into six strictly timed sections (30 minutes each): Analytical Reasoning Skills (Parts 1 & 2), Quantitative Skills (Parts 1 & 2), and Verbal Skills (Parts 1 & 2). Marking scheme: +1 mark for each correct answer; -0.25 mark for each incorrect response (25% negative marking); 0 for unattempted.
